component.name: SimpleHF
component.summary: Select exactly which Hugging Face repository files to download

description.p: SimpleHF shows a model repository as an expandable folder tree. Select files or folders, choose a destination, and follow repository and per-file progress in a torrent-style download view.
Original names and the complete selected directory structure are preserved. Tokens may be supplied for private and gated repositories.
Add an original SimpleHF icon and a standard About dialog with licensing, attribution, and project links.
